Name: Native Stratagem Radial r24 - Cooldown Indicators
Description: Revision 24: native and expanded wheels gray and dim icons during cooldown or delivery. The selected stratagem shows its native remaining time below the name, restoring colors at expiry. Uses the original HUD timer state, including native special cases. Retains all layouts, wedge appearance controls and centering. Requires Mod Options Menu, Mod Bindings Menu v2 and Bingus Shared Loader API 1.
